title: A Soft, Kind Answer
traveler_why: Willow the Warm is the Traveler for a night about gentle words, because tonight the warmth is the lesson: she feels the anger fully and still chooses the soft answer.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because gentle words are her superpower. In Willow’s world today: Willow’s brother knocked over her block tower and she felt her face go hot and mad. She almost yelled — but instead she took a breath and said softly, “That’s okay, will you help me build it again?” Her brother smiled and helped, and the mad feeling floated away. Just like Solomon taught that a soft answer turns anger away, Willow found that gentle words make peace.
